bio:
I'm Tiago, a Cloud and DevOps Engineer based in Portugal. I specialize in building the foundations that digital experiences run on — the infrastructure, the automation, and the invisible scaffolding that either holds everything together or becomes tomorrow's incident report, plus I've developed a very high tolerance for ambiguous error messages.
Outside of work, I'm usually making noise with a guitar, moving heavy things at the gym, or meticulously snapping Lego bricks together. My cat remains unimpressed by all of it.
